drg.description: Simple Pneumonia and Pleurisy without CC/MCC

timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. 63-year-old male admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.63, creatinine 0.92-1.21, hemoglobin 14.6-14.7, platelets 276-280, sodium 141, wbc 6.1-6.6; vitals dbp 77-81, heart_rate 83-88, map 94-97, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-18, sbp 125-129, spo2 97-98, temp 36.6-36.8
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 1.48-1.7, hemoglobin 14.8, platelets 275-282, sodium 140, wbc 6.3-6.4; vitals dbp 77-81, heart_rate 84-87, map 94-95, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 17-18, sbp 123-129, spo2 97-98, temp 36.5-36.7
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Hold lisinopril; Lactated Ringer's 1 L IV bolus
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 63-year-old male, length of stay 3 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed.
